summary.en: Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has seized positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting against Congolese government forces. The United States has imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama for supplying the rebels and is moving to remove Rwanda and South Africa from the AGOA duty-free trade programme. An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has exceeded 5,000 deaths, prompting WHO warnings of a continent-wide spread. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Joseph Kabila leder nå en opprørskoalisjon som inkluderer M23-opprørerne, som har erobret posisjoner i Rugezi etter en ukes kamp mot den kongoske regjeringshæren. USA har innført sanksjoner mot Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og den militære banken Zigama for å ha levert støtte til opprørerne, og vurderer å fjerne Rwanda og Sør-Afrika fra AGOA-programmet med tollfri handel. Et ebolautbrudd i Øst-DR Kongo har overskredet 5 000 dødsfall, og WHO advarer om en spredning over hele kontinentet. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
